desc:
Ad creative preparation with real photos turns your own product images into ads that fit every placement. Ecom Swift LLC writes a short creative brief, designs the layouts with your logo and text, and delivers resized files for feeds, stories and banners.

## What is ad creative preparation?

Ad creative preparation is the work between having photos and having ads that are ready to run. It covers choosing the right image, planning the message, laying out text and logo, and exporting each size a platform expects. The output is a set of finished files, plus a brief that explains the thinking.

We build every ad from photos and product images you approve. We do not invent people, fake reviews or misleading before and after pictures.

## Why the image carries so much of the ad

In a feed, the picture stops the scroll and the words finish the job. A blurry crop, crowded text or the wrong aspect ratio can make a good offer look careless. Each placement also has its own shape, so a layout that works as a square can lose its message when cut to a tall story format.

Good preparation improves the odds that people notice the ad, understand the offer in a second and trust the business behind it. Real photos help with trust, because shoppers can tell when a picture shows the actual product. Results still depend on your offer, audience and budget, but poor creative is a cost you can remove.

## What good ad creative includes

- A clear focal point, so the eye lands on the product or the person using it.
- Your logo, brand colors and fonts applied in the same way across every layout.
- Short text on the image, with a headline and a button that are easy to read on a phone.
- Safe margins, so platform buttons and captions never cover the message.
- Sizes for feed, story and banner placements, each cropped on purpose.
- Light touch ups, such as straightening, cropping and brightness, with no changes to what the product looks like.
- A creative brief that states the audience, the main message and the reason for each layout.
- Consistent templates your team can reuse for later ads.
- A storyboard for a short video when a still image is not enough.
- A cheat sheet of platform specifications, so you know what to upload where.

## How we work

You send the photos you are happy to use, along with your logo and any brand colors. We read your offer and your audience, then write a brief that sets out the message and layout choices. A person designs each ad. Creative tools help us explore ideas and variations quickly, but we check every file by eye for legibility, accuracy and platform fit.

The Basic package gives you a few layouts in two sizes with a brief. Standard adds more layouts in feed, story and banner sizes, headline and button text and a round of changes. Premium adds a larger set, a reusable template set, cropping and light touch ups, a short video storyboard and the platform cheat sheet.

We prepare the files only. Setting up the ads in your account is a separate step you or your marketer controls.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Use photos that show the real product in real light.
- Keep one message per ad.
- Test the layouts on a phone before you publish.
- Leave breathing room around text and logo.
- Keep the original files, so you can create new sizes later.

**Avoid:**
- Putting a paragraph of text on the image.
- Stretching or distorting a photo to fit a shape.
- Using images you do not have the right to use.
- Showing results or claims that the product cannot deliver.
- Using a different look in every ad, which weakens recognition.

## Who this service is for

This service suits a store with good product photos but no designer, so the ads look plain or inconsistent. It suits a small team that runs several promotions a year and wants reusable templates. It also suits a marketer who has the strategy ready and needs fast, accurate production in the sizes each platform asks for.

## What we need from you

Send your approved photos in the best quality you have, your logo, brand colors and any words that must appear. Tell us where the ads will run. Share files by link or upload. We never ask for passwords, and we do not need access to your ad account to prepare the creative.
